authenticity_review: Significant AI artifacts present. Structural collapse in lower bodies: legs/paws merge indistinctly into tall grass with no clear paw-ground contact points, corroborated by pose auditor's MEDIUM risk rating (29% low-confidence keypoints concentrated in hind limbs). Texture anomaly: blue coloration appears uniformly painted-on with plastic-like sheen rather than natural fur pigmentation. Breed features are terrier-type (wiry coat, folded ears) contradicting German Shepherd taxonomy. Faces and upper torsos are reasonably well-rendered, preventing total authenticity failure. Perceptual quality auditor found no graphics-level distortion (noise/compression/blur), so defects are structural/textural rather than rendering artifacts.

Breed mismatch: Dogs display terrier morphology (wiry coat, folded/button ears) vs. German Shepherd taxonomy (erect ears, sloping topline, black-and-tan coat)
